{"metadata":{"description":"⚡ DeepSeek Harness 自定义模型增强插件：在配置第三方提供商时，自动从权威模型库补齐上下文大小、Token 上限、视觉多模态输入与思考强度档位。","id":"gh:1334816648","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-custom-provider-enhancer","slug":"cinob/dsh-plugin-custom-provider-enhancer","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"⚡ DeepSeek Harness 自定义模型增强插件：在配置第三方提供商时，自动从权威模型库补齐上下文大小、Token 上限、视觉多模态输入与思考强度档位。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Custom Provider Enhancer"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**DSH Custom Provider Enhancer** is an out-of-the-box DeepSeek Harness (DSH) / Cordis plugin designe"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"d for **Custom Model Providers** (e.g. OneAPI, NewAPI, OpenRouter, vLLM, Ollama, and OpenAI-compatib"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"del Providers** (e.g. OneAPI, NewAPI, OpenRouter, vLLM, Ollama, and OpenAI-compatible API gateways)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"When discovering or saving models in the Web GUI, it automatically queries a 3000+ model database to"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" populate **Context Window (`contextWindow`)**, **Max Output Tokens (`maxTokens`)**, **Multimodal Vi"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"sion (`input: [text, image]`)**, and **Deep Thinking / Reasoning (`reasoningEfforts`)**."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 🎯 Overview"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### What problem does it solve?
When users connect custom third-party gateways (e.g. OneAPI, NewAPI,"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" vLLM, Ollama) to DeepSeek Harness, the standard `GET /models` discovery endpoint only returns raw m"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"odel IDs (such as `gemini-3.7-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro`, or `mimo-v2.5`). It omits critical runtime "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"parameters:
- ❌ Missing context limits causes inaccurate token pressure metering or context overflow"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"s.
- ❌ Missing multimodal flags (`input: ['text', 'image']`) disables image uploads in the conversat"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ion interface.
- ❌ Missing reasoning levels (`reasoningEfforts`) hides the thinking intensity slider"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"face.
- ❌ Missing reasoning levels (`reasoningEfforts`) hides the thinking intensity slider in chat."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### How does this plugin solve it?
1. **Auto Discovery & Specification Enrichment**: Intercepts `llm"},{"id":"p8s2","text":".discoverModels` and automatically fills correct context size and max output tokens.
2. **Vision & T"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"hinking Auto-Injection**: Intercepts `llm.resolveModelInfo` and `settings.mutate` to automatically a"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ttach vision input and thinking levels both in runtime and in `settings.yaml` (`~/.dsh/settings.yaml"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"`).
3. **Zero Official Interference**: Only affects custom third-party providers; native DeepSeek ch"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"annels remain untouched."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## 🧭 Compatibility"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Environment | Supported Versions | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** | "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"`0.1.0-rc.1` ~ `mainline` | ✅ Verified (Runtime Compatible) |
| **Cordis Framework** | `^3.0.0` | ✅ "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"Verified |
| **Node.js** | `^20.0.0 || ^22.0.0 || >=24.0.0` | ✅ Verified |
| **OS** | Linux, macOS, "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"Windows | ✅ Cross-Platform |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## ✨ Key Features"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- ⚡ **Zero-Config Automation**: Works right out of the box when adding custom providers in Web Setti"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ngs.
- 📏 **Accurate Capacities**: Automatic 1M context for Gemini 3.7 Flash, 1000K for DeepSeek V4 P"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ro, 128K for GPT-4o, 256K for MiMo 2.5, etc.
- 👁️ **Automatic Vision Activation**: Unlocks image upl"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"oads and visual reasoning in Web chat for multimodal models (Gemini, Claude, GPT-4o, MiMo, Qwen-VL, "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"etc.).
- 🧠 **Thinking Intensity Tiers**: Injects reasoning effort gears (`off`, `low`, `medium`, `hi"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"gh`, `max`) for reasoning models.
- 💾 **Dual-Layer Persistence**: Automatically writes clean paramet"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"ers into `settings.yaml` on save, and patches legacy placeholder models in memory.
- 🛡️ **Fault-Tole"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"rant & Offline Fallback**: Built-in 30+ core model definitions, local caching, timeout circuit-break"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"ing, and fuzzy matching for dated model snapshots (`-20241120`)."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"As a standard DSH Profile Bundle, installation is one simple command:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"> **Note**: As a Profile Bundle, the plugin automatically mounts and activates. There is **no need**"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" to manually insert `custom-provider-enhancer` in `profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Uninstallation"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## ⚙️ Configuration"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Optional configuration in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## ⚡ Quick Start"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"1. Start DSH Web GUI (`dsh web`).
2. Go to **Settings ➔ Models ➔ Add Provider**.
3. Fill in your Bas"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"e URL and API Key, then click **Fetch available models**.
4. Check desired models and click **Adopt*"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"*, then click **Save**.
5. All specifications (`contextWindow`, `maxTokens`, `input`, `reasoningEffo"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"rts`) are automatically configured and saved!"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## 🔒 Permissions & Data Security"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Network Access**: Only requests the user-specified custom endpoint `GET /models` and public mode"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"l specification database (`github.com/BerriAI/litellm`).
- **Zero Credential Leaks**: API Keys are p"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"assed through standard authorization headers only during user-initiated discovery; keys are never lo"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"gged, forwarded, or stored by this plugin.
- **Local Sandbox Safe**: Strictly operates in-process th"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"rough Cordis service hooks (`ctx.llm`, `ctx.settings`); creates no subprocesses or arbitrary file mo"},{"id":"p25s6","text":" service hooks (`ctx.llm`, `ctx.settings`); creates no subprocesses or arbitrary file modifications."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## 🛠️ Troubleshooting & Rollback"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **Changes not reflecting**:
Ensure you click **Save** in Web Settings. If models were added prior "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"to installing the plugin, opening Settings and clicking **Save** will auto-enrich them.
- **Rollback"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"**:
Run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-custom-provider-enhancer`."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## 💻 Development & Testing"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## 📄 License"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"MIT License"}],"truncated":false}
